title: Launch HN: Speko (YC S26) – OpenRouter for Voice AI
summary: Speko is a YC S26 startup that provides a platform to automatically find the optimal combination of speech-to-text, LLM, and text-to-speech models for voice AI applications, based on user constraints and their comprehensive benchmarking data across multiple vendors.
problem_solved: Eliminates the time-consuming manual evaluation process of finding the best voice AI model stack from dozens of rapidly evolving options.
why_valuable: Enables developers to make data-driven decisions when building voice agents by providing benchmarked comparisons and recommendations, saving significant evaluation time in a fragmented market.
